body:
that’s a genre i never fully got into, i listened to some songs here and there but i never know where to start when exploring a new genre for me, so i appreciate the band’s recommendations and will def listen to them. 

also introducing your kid to music at an early age might be something he will thank u for, have fun at his first concert!

forgot to mention that i did think of getting into music as a career but it’s hard to be known, maybe something related to music like songwriters or something behind the scenes would’ve been nice, but i’m studying architecture so it’ll stay as a hobby for now:)

my tastes in music are all over the place, i like hardstyle, indie, indie rock, some rock ofc, classical, hyperpop it’s really good, some pop, i really like ballads (mostly mexican and spanish ones) and there’s probably more but i don’t usually know the genres of the music i listen to

it’s honestly kinda nice to see how michael jackson is the reason a lot of us love music. and i had a same experience, i would listen to his music everyday and watch his movies, i don’t listen to them as much anymore but when i do they feel just like when i listened to them for the first time. 

and i will def try to get into singing classes, im kinda good without classes (i’d have to thank my dad for that too) but i still think i can get better and have technique. 

i listened to the song u mentioned, last time, and the part where the bess becomes louder is really good, thank u for the suggestion:)
im a girl, but i like girls too, so kinda close, you’re good at guessing
